business_summary: Jiangsu ChengXing Phosph-Chemicals Co., Ltd. produces and sells chemical raw materials and chemical products in China. It engages in the production, transportation, and sale of yellow phosphorus, phosphoric acid, and phosphate products. Jiangsu ChengXing Phosph-Chemicals Co. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Jiangyin, China.
business_summary_ko: Jiangsu ChengXing Phosph-Chemicals Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 화학 원료 및 화학 제품을 생산 및 판매합니다. 황린, 인산, 인산염 제품의 생산, 운송, 판매를 영위하고 있습니다. Jiangsu ChengXing Phosph-Chemicals Co.는 1994년에 설립되었으며 중국 Jiangyin에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
